title: 49ers WR Pearsall has knee surgery, targets 9-month recovery
dek: San Francisco 49ers WR Ricky Pearsall underwent right knee surgery to repair a posterior cruciate ligament injury and is targeting a nine-month recovery to return for the 2027 season, according to ESPN.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Ricky Pearsall underwent PCL surgery with a nine-month recovery timeline targeting the 2027 season after initial plans to rehabilitate conservatively failed when swelling appeared during training camp.
bottom_line: Pearsall is out for 2026 with a nine-month recovery timeline targeting the 2027 season. What to watch: whether Pearsall returns on schedule by the 2027 offseason decision point, and how the 49ers deploy receiver depth for the remainder of 2026.
body: San Francisco 49ers receiver Ricky Pearsall underwent surgery to repair the posterior cruciate ligament in his right knee, according to ESPN. Recovery is expected to take roughly nine months, with the goal of having Pearsall ready for the start of the 2027 season.

Pearsall initially injured the knee in a Week 4 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars last season, per ESPN. The initial injury cost him all or parts of 10 games last season. After discussions during the offseason, the 49ers and Pearsall opted against surgery in hopes that rehab and rest would allow him to return to full strength, according to ESPN.

However, after just three training camp practices this offseason, Pearsall experienced swelling in the knee, prompting exploration of surgical options. The 49ers placed Pearsall on season-ending injured reserve nearly two weeks ago as of August 13, 2026, per ESPN.

In three seasons, Pearsall has played in 20 games, having missed the first six games of his rookie year after being shot in an attempted robbery in San Francisco before knee issues kept him out for chunks of last season, according to ESPN. For his career, Pearsall has 67 receptions for 928 yards and three touchdowns in 20 games. Pearsall never missed a game at the University of Florida before his professional career, per ESPN.
The 49ers will have to decide on Pearsall's fifth-year option next offseason, according to ESPN.
